notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Baral's Expertise.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand, and casting Dockside Extortionist from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Nivix Guildmage's first ability to loot infinitely.
